notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Company: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). 300 eng+product + data. Using embeddings heavily for feature-store search and in-product assistants.
- Initial interest: started with Hosted API for quick integration (chat + embeddings). After hosted demo, they requested Dedicated for predictable cost and data isolation.
- POC objective: validate Dedicated throughput/latency at 500 concurrent chat sessions; evaluate canary rollout + cross-region failover behavior; measure cost delta vs hosted.
- Acceptance criteria (agreed): p50 <= 120ms token-gen, p95 <= 420ms across typical requests (prompt length 256 tokens); end-to-end 99th <= 800ms for chat. Error rate < 1% (5xx).
- Canary plan (POC): start with 10% traffic to Dedicated cluster in us-east-1 for 48h -> metrics pass -> ramp to 50% -> 7 day soak -> full cutover. Canary traffic will use model-variant "redwood-2-small-q4" (quantized variant) while hosted uses "redwood-2-base" as control. Will compare quality via eval prompts (scoring harness provided).
- Fallback routing: primary region us-east-1 (Dedicated). On capacity or health degradation (latency breach or >0.8% 5xx for 5m), traffic fails over to hosted API in us-west-2; secondary failover to eu-west-1 hosted if region-level outage. Routing policy must preserve customer tenant routing and tokenization.
- Model variant & rollback rules: if automatic quality drift detected (BLEU-like / eval score drop >4% on control suite) OR latency SLA breach at p95 for >15m -> automatic rollback to previous model variant and route back to hosted. Manual rollback also possible via Console.
- Observability needs: token-level cost breakdown, per-route p50/p95, request traces linked to prompt ids, KV-cache hit rate, rate of cold starts for large context loads. Need access to 30-day trace retention during POC.
- Security & compliance: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and confirmation of data residency for EU customers.
- Pricing: negotiating committed monthly tier for Dedicated (target ARR 75k-150k). They want a 3-month POC discount and a hard cap on monthly overage for first quarter.
- Legal: in review — NGDPR clause + data residency appendix requested. Legal to re-review by 2026-04-10.
- Quotes from calls: "Need predictable tail latency — we can't have spikes during demo days"; "We like the unified API but need clear rollback and canary playbook".
- Action items: AE to circulate final POC SOW; SE to produce canary metric dashboard template; infra to confirm VPC peering and egress path; security to provide KMS integration doc.
- Risk notes: somewhat price sensitive; will re-evaluate if hosted unit cost + dedicated infra overhead >20% delta vs current budget.
use_case_summary: Primary use: in-product conversational assistant + semantic search. Reranking for search results and real-time summarization for customer support reps. Need predictable latency and data isolation. POC is focused on Dedicated with canary + fallback to hosted to prove reliability and rollback mechanics.
